label: PF Backlog 585
title: Eventing SSOT: bus daemon/service run model + ops (start/stop/status)
body:
## Problem / why
Cross-process dispatch + webhook/alert delivery need an always-on Go component; ops must be observable.

## Goal / value
A Go bus daemon run model with start/stop/status (reuse the portfolio supervisor pattern) invoked via API.

## In scope
- Daemon lifecycle + ops endpoints; heartbeats/health; no new Python service.

## Out of scope
- Dispatcher internals (E4).

## Acceptance criteria
- Daemon start/stop/status works; dispatcher runs across process boundaries; fail-closed if down.

## Verification / test plan
- Lifecycle test; health check in /health.
